sn35.69:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā ca Sāriputto āyasmā ca Upaseno Rājagahe viharanti sītavane sappasoṇḍikapabbhāre || || 2
sn35.69:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Upasenassa kāye āsīviso patito hoti || || 3
sn35.69:1.3: Atha kho āyasmā Upaseno bhikkhū āmantesi || ||
sn35.69:1.4: Etha me āvuso imaṃ kāyam mañcakam āropetvā bahiddhā nīharatha
sn35.69:2.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Sāriputto āyasmantam Upasenam etad avoca || ||
sn35.69:2.2: Na kho pana mayam passāma āyasmato Upasenassa kāyassa vā aññathattam indriyānaṃ vā vipariṇāmaṃ || || 5
sn35.69:2.4: Etha me āvuso imaṃ kāyam mañcakam āropetvā bahiddhā nīharatha
sn35.69:2.7: Yassa nuna āvuso Sāriputta evam assa
sn35.69:2.8: Ahaṃ cakkhunti Mama cakkhunti vā || la ||
sn35.69:2.9: Ahaṃ jivhā ti vā Mama jivhāti vā || ||
sn35.69:2.10: Aham mano ti vā Mama manoti vā ||
sn35.69:2.11: tassa āvuso Sariputta siyā kāyassa vā aññathattam indriyānaṃ vā pariṇāmo || ||
sn35.69:2.12: Mayhañca kho āvuso Sāriputta na evaṃ hoti ||
sn35.69:2.13: Ahaṃ cakkhunti vā Mama cakkhunti vā || la ||
sn35.69:2.14: Ahaṃ jivhāti vā Mama jivhāti va || ||
sn35.69:2.15: Ahaṃ manoti vā Mama manoti vā ||
sn35.69:2.16: tassa mayham āvuso Sāriputta kiṃ kāyassa vā aññathattam bhavissati indriyānaṃ vā vipariṇāmoti || || 7
sn35.69:3.1: Tathā hi panāyasmato Upasenassa dīgharattam ahaṃkāra-mamaṃkāra-mānānusayā susamūhatā ||
sn35.69:3.2: tasmā āyasmato Upasenassa na evaṃ hoti ||
